unknowns.why: both names exist (keyboard) but no file says which mode consumes them, and G2-11 found 2 driver weapon slots with no switch action.

unknowns.why: the class is the root object of the .epe (CCar / CBoat / CHelicopter / CAirPlane / CTrain / CMotorBike, FORCEPULSE §owners); nothing in the keymap files or the entities names a class to pick a scheme. The selection is native.
no TURRET action exists; PRECISION_AIM and the LOOK_* axes are the only candidates, and the hinge wiring is native (TURRET.md).

unknowns.what: why 26 binding ids are not `H(action name)`
unknowns.why: the id equals the Jenkins hash of the action name for 448 of 474 bindings and none of the other candidates for the remainder (counts printed above). The remaining ids are stable across the base and patch copies of the same action, so they were fixed before the current name or by another rule; which one is not in any decoded file.

unknowns.what: the `PP` prefix on the stored input string
unknowns.why: the bytes are `PP`+input and the property's offset points 2 bytes past it, so `PP` is a fixed prefix on every input string in both files; what it encodes is not in any decoded file.
